lines.en: I move along singing.
This body has no legs.
The tiles below scrape the ground.
I sing and slide forward.
My voice reaches far ahead of me.
The echoes here are enormous.
I slide around a corner.
The tiles knock the doorframe.
The lights in the hall tremble.
I dare not stop for long.
Stop too long and I must wonder what I am.
This door is too small; I must squeeze.
The tiles scrape the floor evenly.
I count doors as I slide.
I hover with my mouth still moving.
I have held this pose a long time.
My head turns; the body does not.
I am listening to the other end of the hall.
Water runs somewhere in the pipes.
I tilt my head to one side.
There is nobody on this floor.
Not a single cup of water.
I am a little thirsty.
That is a long story.
My song has never stopped.
I rest my head against the tiles.
The pipes here have rusted.
I count the hall lights.
You come walking from over there.

lines.zh: 你还在山那头，我已经盯着你。
lines.en: You're still beyond the hill; I'm already watching.
You walk quite steadily.
The lights of this floor fall on you.

lines.zh: 隔着一千格，我就看见你手里的东西。
lines.en: A thousand blocks off, I see what's in your hand.
Never mind if you do not.

lines.zh: 一千格外，我就看见你了。
lines.en: A thousand blocks out, I see you.
I follow that shadow.
You have not heard me sing yet.

lines.zh: 我的歌声贴上你的后颈。
lines.en: My song settles on the back of your neck.
You turned your head.
The light hits me; I narrow my eyes.
It lights my tiles.
The glare stings a little.

lines.zh: 水箱晃了晃，水洒了一地。
lines.en: My tank sloshes and water spills everywhere.
One tile has cracked.
The song breaks off.
I keep singing.

lines.zh: 瓷面裂了条缝，我照样往前冲。
lines.en: A crack splits my porcelain; still I charge.

lines.zh: 你这一下打得我嗡嗡响。
lines.en: That hit left my head ringing.
I retreat a little down the hall.
One tile has come loose.

lines.zh: 头歪了，我用两只手扶正。
lines.en: My head tilts; I straighten it with both hands.
The water inside sloshes.
Water? Did you bring water?
No, that does not look like water.
That will do, though.
Set it on the floor.
I cannot reach that high.

lines.zh: 一百格外的你，我也看得见。
lines.en: I can see you a thousand blocks away.
I will get it myself.
What about that bottle in your hand?
I saw it.
Do not hide it behind your back.
You hit the tiles.
A loud sound.
This body is hard.
You stepped half back.
I shift myself aside.
The corridor was already narrow.
You stepped on my edge.
It breaks easily there.
I pull in a little.
I stop still in the middle of the corridor.
This subject is very strange.
I do not even have legs.
Let us not.
Do you have another question?
My song is more interesting than this.

lines.zh: 一千格外，我就闻到你的动静。
lines.en: I smell your movement from a thousand blocks off.
You can tell.
I cannot even piece my memory together.

lines.zh: 这副样子是别人给我拼的。
lines.en: Someone else put me in this shape.
You are asking far too much.
Something fell to the floor.
I lower myself to look.
It is a shard of tile.
Not food.

lines.zh: 地上那点东西，被我一脚踢开。
lines.en: That little thing on the ground gets kicked aside.
I duck and my tiles touch the floor.
One clack.
It rolled out of reach.
It is wedged in a wall seam.
I cannot get in there.

lines.zh: 你在很远的地方我就看见了。
lines.en: I saw you from very far off.
A thousand blocks is not far.
I turn toward you.
There is only one hallway.
You will not get away.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声我早听见了。
lines.en: I heard your steps long ago.
The whole floor could hear.
I will wait for you here.
I am in the middle of the hall.
Either end you come from, it is the same.
You are directly in front of me.
There is only one way down this hall.
I sing as I follow.
The sound bounces off the walls.
Covering your ears will not help.
I keep sliding this way.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的歌声，顺着风过来。
lines.en: The song in my throat rides the wind to you.

lines.zh: 你踩断树枝，我在远处转过马桶。
lines.en: A twig snaps; far away, my toilet head turns.
You are running; your steps are messy.
That corridor is sealed.
You did not know.
I have been sliding toward you all along.
The sound is getting nearer.

lines.zh: 我滚过山坡，轮子压碎一路草。
lines.en: I roll over the slope, wheels crushing the grass.
I ram my body at you.
The tile edges arrive first.
That one was not heavy yet.
But I keep ramming.
You are forced to the wall.
I throw my head forward.
Your hand catches it.
The tiles did not break.
A tile is missing from my body.
Higher this time.
A sound comes from the end of the corridor.
It is my song.
I slide in from the corner.
A wet trail remains on the floor.
This place will do.
Nobody comes here.
Then let us sing.

lines.zh: 我从天花板下面的管道口出来。
lines.en: I come out of a pipe mouth below the ceiling.
The floor is a little wet.
A hall light flickers.
I slide slowly out.
A clatter comes from the pipes.

lines.zh: 火烤着瓷砖，缝里冒出白气。
lines.en: Fire heats the tiles and steam rises from the seams.
I tip over the stairwell edge.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，这倒是我的地盘。
lines.en: Water rises; this is my element.
The blast lifts a row of tiles.
An arrow sticks between two tiles.

lines.zh: 那光让我的声音一下哑了。
lines.en: That light cuts my voice off.
In this shape I cannot starve.

lines.zh: 雷打在瓷砖上，一路传到里面。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tiles and runs inward.
The floor is gone and I slide down.
